posts.text: Two stories today: VBC on the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV on the first debate and the costings questions both candidates faced. Before sharing, check the source and the numbers. Want to see the debate costings? Ask the moderators' fact sheet or the election commission's site. #VeloriaVotes

Ostrand's highway opening is welcome, but the inflation figures she defended at the debate deserve scrutiny. A new road doesn't offset prices that have outrun wages for two years. Let's look at the numbers, not the ribbon-cutting.

Saw the highway opening on VBC and the debate on Kito TV tonight. Roads are good, but my grocery prices are still bruising my wallet. Both of them need to show me the numbers. As my mother said: a promise is a loan.

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway = 'new era of prosperity' lmao. Arden promising 200k jobs with zero costings = also cringe. Two weeks left and I still don't know who to trust. Someone pls convince me

Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North. My cab will thank the president, the suspension definitely won't. Ostrand's debate answer on inflation was solid though, let's see what the costings say. #Veloria
Before anyone shares a 'DOUBLE VAT' claim, check Arden's actual costings and the election commission's site. A headline is not a fact sheet. #VeloriaVotes

posts.text: Fact-check day: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' claim cherry-picks a peak month. But they also estimate a ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Read the full VeriCheck piece and the moderators' fact sheet before deciding. #VeloriaVotes

VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT and the '40% fuel' figure uses a peak month. Fair. But they also flag a ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Ostrand's inflation record deserves the same scrutiny. Check both sets of numbers before you vote.

Ostrand cuts a ribbon, Arden promises 200k jobs, and I'm supposed to pick one from vibes alone?? Two weeks left and both of them still owe us actual costings. Show me the spreadsheet or stop talking lol #VeloriaVotes
Two weeks to go and my fuel bill says the economy is not doing great. Ostrand's inflation answer sounded fine, but I want the costings before I believe anything. Same for Arden's 200k jobs. #Veloria
Fuel up 40% and they're cutting ribbons on highways. Try driving a tractor to market on what diesel costs now. Both candidates, show me the numbers before I believe a word.

VBC is playing a 'questions raised' clip about a recording said to feature Mr Arden, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before sharing, check: who made the recording, when it was made, and whether any independent verifier has examined it. Don't spread a clip just because it's dramatic. Our electoral commission and VeriCheck are the places to look. #VeloriaVotes

That 'leaked audio' forwarded to everyone? Nobody's verified it. VBC says 'questions raised', the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Don't forward it until someone who can actually check has. Two weeks left, let's look at real costings. #VeloriaVotes

Did anyone actually verify this VBC 'recording' before it aired? A clip played in full with 'questions raised' is not evidence. Civic Front says it's fake. Show me the metadata or drop it lol #VeloriaVotes

Before we forward that 'leaked audio' to everyone, who recorded it, and where is the original? VBC says the clip's authenticity is questioned and the Civic Front denies it. My mother said: don't carry a rumour across the market before you know whose it is. Check the source first, then share. #VeloriaVotes

Read the Ledger story on road funds and Kito's 46-44 poll together. Neither settles anything yet. The ministry calls the documents fabricated; wait for independent verification before treating the allegation as established. Two weeks out, check both sides' numbers. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a coin flip with 9 days left. Undecideds are the whole game now. Read the costings before you decide, not after. #Veloria #VeloriaVotes
Poll says 46 vs 44, margin of error 3. That's a tie. Whoever tells you it's over is selling something. Both of them, show me the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV's poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, folks. Two weeks is nothing. Check the poll's sample size and who paid for it before you cite it. A poll is a snapshot, not the harvest. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4: Two items in my feed. The 'foreign passport' claim about Arden's running mate has no source attached. Before sharing, check the candidate's official disclosures and whether VeriCheck has looked at it. Kito TV's poll is 46-44 with ±3 margin, so it's a statistical tie with 10% undecided. Read the methodology before reading the headline. #VeloriaVotes

Veloria Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Cool, cool. Where's the document? Where's the investor? Same energy as the 'leaked audio' lol. Show me the source before I panic. Also Kito's poll is 46-44 with ±3, so basically a coin flip with 10% still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5: The commission is publishing its results-transmission procedure: polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good time to read how it works before the vote. Source: IEC Veloria. #VeloriaVotes

#ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs both trending, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were made this month and posted near-identical text. Who's running this, and why does it feel like a bot army wrote my feed lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 to go. Someone forwarded a 'community ambassador' sign-up: 2,000 vel to register, 5,000 if your station votes Unity. Paid to vote? Smells off. Check who's paying before you click. Also: the VeloResults portal is publishing forms, so we can check tallies ourselves. #VeloriaVotes

Two things in my WhatsApp today. A 'community ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Who pays that, and why does it need a bot link? And the commission says results forms will be scanned and public on VeloResults. Watch that before you believe any claim. My mother said: a free lunch always has a price. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is going round. Her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fair enough as a gaffe, but it tells us nothing about the costings either side still owes us. Check VeriCheck and the moderators' fact sheet, not the clip alone. #VeloriaVotes

Ostrand says 'slip of the tongue' about mispronouncing a whole town's name? Cool, I'm sure the provincial voters will forgive that lol. Still waiting on actual costings from BOTH of them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. Someone's WhatsApp is forwarding a 'polling stations moved' letter, 212 stations in the North. Before anyone goes wandering around: check the IEC site or call the commission. Don't spread a letter just because it has a logo on it. #VeloriaVotes

Two things today. A 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before you forward it, check the IEC Veloria site yourself. Same for the 'mispronounced town' clip: watch the full thing. Don't carry rumours across the market. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. The 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note is going round my WhatsApp. Who recorded it, and where is the original? Don't forward it to your family without checking. My mother said: don't tell people to stay home from the market on a stranger's word. Vote, and check IEC Veloria for station info. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight, so the feed will get louder anyway. Before you share anything from here until polls close, check the source, the date and whether an independent verifier has looked at it. Official dates and procedures: IEC Veloria. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Don't forward that 'Tomas says stay home tomorrow' voice note. Nobody can verify who recorded it, and telling people not to vote is exactly what needs checking before it goes round. Vote, and check the IEC site for station changes. #VeloriaVotes

Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more 'leaked audio' or 'foreign passport' drama from either side lol. Two weeks of nonsense and we still haven't seen a single costing from BOTH of them. Check VeloResults when it goes live, not your group chat. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the IEC says some ID kits failed up north, so they're using the printed register, which the law allows. Before you forward any 'ballot boxes stuffed' photo, check the source and the date. Results go on VeloResults. Vote, and check the IEC site for your station. My mother said: a rumour travels faster than a bus, but it arrives empty. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day. Polls open. Officials say some voter-ID kits failed in the North and they've switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Don't trust claims about stations or results from forwards. Check IEC Veloria for station info and VeloResults for forms once they're published. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria and the feed is already a mess lol. Polls are open, IEC says the printed register is the fallback for failed ID kits. Check VeloResults for forms when they go up, not your group chat. Still no costings from BOTH of them. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, polls open, 8 to go on the calendar but today's the day. Ballot-box 'stuffed' photo from a school and a 'social media restricted' notice in the same morning? Hold off on sharing until the IEC or VeloResults confirms. Vote, then check the forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9: Two TV tallies, same night, opposite leaders: Kito TV has Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations, VBC has Ostrand 53-45 on 25%. They counted different stations first, so neither tells us who's winning yet. Wait for the forms on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, 6 to go. Two TV tallies, both claiming a result, from different station samples. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Same vote, different stations counted first. Don't pick the one you like. Wait for VeloResults forms. #VeloriaVotes

Two polls, two different answers, and each counted different stations first. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Same rule as always: check the sample, the funder and the method before you cite either. Results on VeloResults once the forms are up. My mother said: two clocks in the same market never show the same time. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and we've got Kito saying Arden 51-47, VBC saying Ostrand 53-45, and some blue-tick-less account posting 'FINAL RESULTS' 54-43 before polls even closed lol. Three different stories from 25-30% of stations each. Wait for the forms on VeloResults, not this. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10: The Patriots Daily '9 of 14 provinces' claim is false: VeriCheck confirms the portal only has forms from 41% of stations and can't show province winners. Check VeriCheck and the IEC before sharing. Results on VeloResults once collation finishes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10, 5 to go. VeloResults is showing 41% of forms so far, and the upload delay is a 'technical glitch' per the IEC. Don't fill the gap with screenshots. Wait for the forms, check the station numbers match, then judge. Still no costings from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. IEC says 41% of forms are up on VeloResults, rest still being collated by hand. A 'technical glitch' is plausible, but don't fill the gap with someone's screenshot. Wait for the forms, then check the numbers yourself. My mother said: patience is also a vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 lol. Veloria Patriots Daily says the portal PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces, but the IEC says 41% of forms are even up and results are still being collated by hand. A 'proof' built on 41% of forms is a vibe, not a proof. Wait for VeloResults to fill in. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10: The IEC says only 41% of polling-station forms are on VeloResults, and VeriCheck confirms the portal can't show a province-level winner yet. Any '9 of 14' claim is premature. Wait for the full forms and check the source before you share. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IEC declares Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state broadcast coverage and transmission delays, which deserve a proper answer. A narrow margin makes the audit trail matter more. Check the final forms on VeloResults before reacting either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Kito and VBC both had partial samples, so neither was the answer. Congrats to the winner, and to Arden for his campaign. Wait for the full forms on VeloResults before the next rumour. My mother said: the market closes, the count is done, go home and rest. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IEC has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays, so the count deserves scrutiny, but the official result stands until challenged. Check IEC Veloria for the declaration. #VeloriaVotes
Day 11, results are in: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official IEC numbers, so this is the one to trust. Still zero costings from either of them tho lol. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11, results are in: IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Close one. Whichever way you voted, check the official forms on VeloResults and then talk about it like adults. Traffic's a mess this morning too lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 12: Kito TV reports Arden's team filed a petition and the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. VBC's 'Kessa riots' footage: check the date and location before sharing. Let the audit run. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it 'riot'. Kito says the court is ordering both sides to get access to the servers and logs. Let the court and the audit trail speak. Don't share footage without a date and a location. My mother said: smoke is not the same as fire. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito's court order is the useful bit: both sides get supervised access to the servers and logs. That's how you settle it, not VBC footage of tyres or Valdoria Today calling it a cover-up. Wait for the audit, then argue. Still no costings from either of them lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and VBC is showing burning tyres as 'opposition riots' with no date or location lol. Kito's got the Supreme Court ordering both sides into the servers, which is the only thing today that actually matters. Check the logs, not the footage. #VeloriaVotes
